findings.evidence: TauCeti/Algebra/Ring/NegOnePow.lean:153 already proves a.negOnePow * b.negOnePow = c.negOnePow from Even (a + b - c); Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/NegOnePow.lean:32,42 provide the two simplifications.
